description: Defines classes and interfaces for handling HTTP digest authentication, including nonce generation strategies and the main HttpAuthHandlerDigest class.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandlerDigest
classes.description: Main class for handling HTTP digest authentication, including parsing challenges and generating auth tokens.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandlerDigest::NonceGenerator
classes.description: Interface for generating client nonces, allowing for different nonce generation strategies.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandlerDigest::DynamicNonceGenerator
classes.description: Generates a nonce by shuffling characters randomly.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandlerDigest::FixedNonceGenerator
classes.description: Generates a fixed nonce specified at construction.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandlerDigest::Factory
classes.description: Factory class for creating HttpAuthHandlerDigest instances, managing nonce generators.

methods.name: GenerateNonce
methods.description: Generates a client nonce, implemented differently in each nonce generator.

methods.name: CreateAuthHandler
methods.description: Creates an HTTP auth handler based on the challenge and context.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the handler with challenge data.

methods.name: GenerateAuthTokenImpl
methods.description: Generates the authentication token based on credentials and request.

methods.name: HandleAnotherChallengeImpl
methods.description: Handles additional challenges from the server.

methods.name: ParseChallengeProperty
methods.description: Parses individual properties from the challenge.

methods.name: AssembleResponseDigest
methods.description: Builds the response digest for the Authorization header.

methods.name: AssembleCredentials
methods.description: Builds the credentials string for the Authorization header.

methods.name: GetRequestMethodAndPath
methods.description: Extracts HTTP method and path from the request.
